correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct Cayley-Hamilton recurrence gives P_n=af_n-df_{n-1} and normalized symmetric J_n(c) continuant. Irreducible tridiagonal J has simple real spectrum with strict interlacing, rank-one c perturbation fixes signs and bounds all but largest in (-2,2). det(2I-J)=n+1-cn yields exact focus-edge crossing c=(n+1)/n. The hyperbolic eigenvalue equation lambda^{2n+1}(lambda-c)=1-c lambda gives limit c+c^-1 and expansion coefficient (c²-1)² c^(-2n-3) in t. Rank-one spectral counting gives arcsine bulk and complete accumulation set. Independent numerical/high-precision spectral edge and recurrence checks confirm 25+ finite parameter instances; finite checks do not establish all n. No admissibility of R^nL itineraries claimed.
